name: astra
description: Reference for ASTRA 0.1 (astra.yaml) and its `astra` CLI: inputs tracked in git, outputs and their recipes, decisions and options, universes written in astra.yaml, declared analyses read by address, prior insights and findings with evidence and quote verification, how results stand against their records, and upgrading a 0.0.x spec. Invoke when reading, writing, validating, or debugging an astra.yaml spec, or when the user asks about ASTRA. Ships hooks that validate astra.yaml on save and orient agents at session start in an ASTRA project.
